entities.name: Itlimoc
entities.description: Sacred forest in Ixalan's interior, the Cradle of the Sun's Radiance, protected by the River Heralds.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who dwelled in Ixalan's interior and protect Itlimoc.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: City-state west of Itlimoc, later the golden city reclaimed by the River Heralds.

entities.name: Chacanto Intli
entities.description: Leader who raised Orazca and united neighboring city-states.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli I
entities.description: Descendant of Chacanto who used the Immortal Sun to try to conquer merfolk lands.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: Planeswalker who intervened and cast a spell making humans forget Orazca's location.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: Coastal city humans established east of Itlimoc.

events.summary: Apatzec Intli I harnessed the Immortal Sun to try to conquer the merfolk's sacred lands; Azor intervened.
events.quote: This aggression brought the planeswalker Azor to intervene.

events.summary: The River Heralds overthrew Orazca's human rulers and reclaimed the golden city, pushing the humans east.
events.quote: the River Heralds overthrew Orazca's human rulers and reclaimed the golden city

events.summary: Azor cast a spell making the humans forget the golden city's location.
events.quote: A spell cast by Azor ensured that the golden city's location was forgotten by the humans

relations.quote: gradually rose to prominence under the ambitious leadership of Chacanto Intli
